# JSDoc

Source: https://github.com/Alpaq92/JSDoc, commit 821695a884e0c0bb8592a635d9524bb3e116cd67, src/docToText.js.
License: 0BSD, retained in JSDoc-LICENSE. Only adaptation: UMD wrapper replaced by ESM default export. No HTML renderer is called; the app extracts body text only inside a bounded browser Worker. No network APIs or document execution.

The legacy.doc fixture comes from samples/feature-showcase.doc in the same revision, public-domain/generated content according to upstream README. No real candidate data is included.
